verdict.rationale: Phaser is a browser-first 2D framework: the docs say games are built for the web and distributed via npm or the jsDelivr CDN, and community reports confirm it renders through both Canvas and WebGL. No first-party evidence covers bundle size or payload. The only WebGPU evidence is a community comment that WebGPU support was deferred to Phaser 4; Phaser 4 has since shipped (4.2.1 on npm), but nothing documents WebGPU in it. Missing for 10: any payload/bundle-size evidence, first-party WebGL renderer documentation, a documented WebGPU renderer or roadmap.
